unsupported: International Crankshaft Inc. (ICI) operates from Georgetown, Kentucky, where it was founded in 1992 as a single-line forge shop.
The company is a subsidiary of Nippon Steel Corporation, the world's largest steel group by market capitalization, and has grown steadily since its inception.
Over three decades it has expanded to four forging lines, including a 5,000-ton high-speed press installed in 2015 from Sumitomo Heavy Industries.
The company serves automotive original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers, focusing on crankshafts for passenger cars and light trucks.
Its customer base includes major North American vehicle producers that rely on ICI's forging expertise.

Known for: Four forging lines including a 5,000-ton high-speed press (Sumitomo Heavy Industries); Part of Nippon Steel Corporation Group; IATF 16949 and ISO 14001 certified; Forged over 3 million crankshafts annually for North American automotive OEMs (2015)
